name: Ice Elemental

actions.name: Ice Fist
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or have their movement halved for 1 round.

actions.name: Frost Breath
actions.effect: 6m cone. All targets must pass PHYS save or be encased in ice (restrained) for 1 round. PHYS save at end of turn to break free.

actions.name: Ice Spike
actions.effect: Ranged attack. A javelin of ice launches at a target.

reactions.name: Flash Freeze
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack, the attacker's weapon or limb freezes to the elemental. Attacker must pass PHYS save or lose their weapon (it's frozen in place) or take 2d8 cold damage.

traits.name: Freezing Aura
traits.desc: Water freezes within 6m of the elemental. The ground in this radius is difficult terrain for non-cold-immune creatures.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: Can move across icy surfaces without needing to make checks. Difficult terrain from ice does not affect it.

lore: Ice Elementals form where the planes of water and air converge in biting cold. They are living glaciers, slow but inexorable, freezing everything they touch solid.
